title: Roborock Qrevo Edge 2 Pro $1,488 Del / C&C @ About Clean (Price Match & 20% off StoreCash Signup $1190.40 @ The Good Guys)
body:
Deal: Roborock Qrevo Edge 2 Pro $1,488 Del / C&C @ About Clean (Price Match & 20% off StoreCash Signup $1190.40 @ The Good Guys)

[Roe Jogan] i wonder if this is worth it vs edge 1 that i got, which comes Monday estimate, i mean i could realistically still cancel it. ill have to ai a full comparison though see if its worth the price difference
[Dollar Dreamer] If I were you, I would wait for the Edge 3 in 2027 - 2028. Usually it's the 3rd gen when all the issues are ironed out from Beta testers buying Gen 1 and 2. Problem is Edge 4 will be coming out soon after that…..and that one will have arms and legs and will be able to walk up and down the stairs.
[Roe Jogan] relax bro, my order has not been delivered yet so its worth a comparison. but after a quick compare its not worth it, it has mop detachment and 25000 instead of 18500, and slightly slimmer but i dont have use for that as all my furniture are super low. so tbh not worth the upgrade just for one extra feature to leave mop at base and slightly stronger vacuum for 400 dollars more
[Dollar Dreamer] Plus this new 2026 model is a lot more $$$ than what you paid for the older 2025 Edge 1 Ozbargain deal.
[Captain Yobbo] The suction figures are worthless. I have a couple of Lubluelu SL60D units and they leave my hard floors absolutely spotless, they definitely aren't that powerful. Higher numbers suggest it will be noisier.
[OzComment] @Captain Yobbo: Exactly. My 3-year-old S7 MaxV only has 5,100 Pa suction power on paper. Also I'm sure a lot of us are just using the "balanced" power setting but nobody has ever complained about its suction.
[Captain Yobbo] @OzComment: Not to brag but I got my ~$180 LBLs in 20222, changed 1 battery ($35) and one set of brushes, no idea what the suction rating is! I think it's just another marketing gimmick for this particular class of products.
[gadgetguy] Edge 3 Pro is already announced, probably for sale soon:
https://global.roborock.com/pages/roborock-qrevo-edge-3-pro
I haven't even unboxed my Edge 2 Pro yet!
[Puglife] Slightly quieter, slightly better edge mopping/cleaning, i think the mop washing is hotter and quicker. And it is better at obstacle avoidance like cables. But is it worth the extra cost, probably not.
I paid about $730 after discounts so its not enough for the $450+
[Roe Jogan] well i paid 600 for the edge, i had 200 bonus sign up credit for amazon business that had accumulated, so its like half price of this
[hopper] i like how thin this is compared to edge1. easy to go under furniture
[dan0909] Wasn't this $850 end of June. in EOFY? I bought one it's good
[bruce1202] Up until now, i still do not know which robot vacuum is functioning better….so many specs across so many brands
[OzComment] Honestly, there isn't much difference. You're safe just getting the cheaper one.
[bruce1202] Which types of mobs is better? Spinning or roller mobs?
[OzComment] Roller is technically superior, they usually offer higher downforce and continuously self-clean while they run instead of having to go back to the base station on a regular basis to clean the pads. But in the real world? The difference is not night and day and spinning mops still do a good job for everyday cleaning.
[clausman] I tried this via their online chat and they wouldn’t stack both price beat and the 20%… wonder if going to store will allow this
[dazzza] Good question. I reckon you have better luck in store. I also have a spend 150 get 30 off, not sure if can stack all these
[clausman] @Cheezbrgr mind sharing receipt for us to price match (if you did it in TGG)? 😁
[gadgetguy] Compared to Edge 2 (not Edge):
This one is white, not black, has 100 degrees C mop drying, "Industry-First AdaptiLift chassis", auto detergent dispenser, bigger battery/longer runtime and detachable mops (in the dock) system for cleaning/drying. Also has pop-up/pop down Lidar to lower its profile and a video camera to monitor/record your pets.
[KVTKiwi] Got one of these with perks/gift cards for around ~$1000 in the EOFY sales. Pretty happy with it so far
